dimensions.assessment: Affects federal lead agencies, the Council on Environmental Quality, and stakeholders involved in federal projects requiring NEPA reviews.
dimensions.evidence: the head of each lead agency shall submit to the Council on Environmental Quality a report

dimensions.assessment: Establishes administrative data collection, tracking, and reporting requirements without altering underlying environmental review standards.
dimensions.evidence: publish the reports received under subsection (a) on the website of the Council on Environmental Quality

dimensions.assessment: Requires agencies to estimate preparation costs for environmental impact statements, but states no specific federal spending figures.
dimensions.evidence: an estimate of the cost to prepare the environmental impact statements described in paragraph (2)

dimensions.assessment: Amends Section 201 of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 to create a comprehensive, multi-sector annual reporting framework.
dimensions.evidence: amended to read as follows: SEC. 201. ANNUAL REPORTS ON NEPA'S IMPACT ON PROJECTS.

dimensions.assessment: Mandates ongoing annual reports with specific data disaggregations tied to statutory timelines through 2033.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than July 1, 2026, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Total administrative costs for compiling the new reports are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates annual reporting by lead federal agencies and the Council on Environmental Quality regarding NEPA litigation, environmental impact statements, costs, and timelines.
